728-3652-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Ornithopter is starting in your graveyard.
728-3652-5006-8170.description:
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Ornithopter spell. Then, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Ornithopter, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat.

1659-7084-7272.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
1659-7084-7272.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Seed the Land triggers, creating a 1/1 green Snake creature token
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1719-2645-3430-3861.easyPrerequisites: Vizier of Tumbling Sands doesn't have summoning sickness.
1719-2645-3430-3861.description:
Activate Orzhov Basilica by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}{B}{B}{B} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Orzhov Basilica
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1339-1832-2034-5931.easyPrerequisites:
Funeral Room is unlocked.
Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-2034-5931.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}
When the Insect dies, Funeral Room triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

522-2511--5.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Melira.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

2018-3899-5263.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero with a flying counter on it.
Resolve both Spawning Pit abilities from steps 1 and 3
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2921-4019-6972.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Vigean Graftmage.
When Vigean Graftmage dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2921-6094.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1417-2946-4871-5147.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
1417-2946-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5256-5542-6135.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5256-5542-6135.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Aarakocra Sneak from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Aarakocra Sneak enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Aarakocra Sneak.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Aarakocra Sneak that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Aarakocra Sneak token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Aarakocra Sneak token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Aarakocra Sneak that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Aarakocra Sneak trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5256-5542-6135.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

3129-5702--143.manaNeeded: {2}{G} plus enough mana to animate the land
3129-5702--143.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a land that doesn't have summoning sickness and that can tap to produce at least {G}.
3129-5702--143.description:
Earthbend a land that can tap to produce at least {G}, thus animating it.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated land.
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the land it is attached to due to Primal Vigor.
When the land tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the two land tokens by tapping them, adding at least {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and create two 1/1 Insect creature tokens due to Primal Vigor
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the land it is attached to due to Primal Vigor.
Repeat from step 5.

3755-7175-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
3755-7175-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
3755-7175-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

49-2034-4871-7147-7729.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {1}{U}.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and adding {R}.
Repeat.

2103-7715-7722.easyPrerequisites: The Mighty Thor doesn't have summoning sickness.
2103-7715-7722.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using The Mighty Thor.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Capture of Jingzhou from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

254-6797--5.description:
Cast First Day of Class by paying {1}{R}.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, First Day of Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 2

147-6798-7446.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-6798-7446.description:
Cast Moment of Reckoning by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Moment of Reckoning.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Moment of Reckoning
Resolve the Moment of Reckoning copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-6798-7446.notes: You can choose as many modes as allowed with Moment of Reckoning. You must choose the second mode once, but the other three can be as desired.

140-3705-5231-5997.description:
Activate Rowan by tapping it, causing black and red spells you cast to cost {1} less for each life you've lost this turn.
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

967-2292-3129-3809-7087.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

2425-4050-5010-7028.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {B}.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Smothering Abomination trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Resolve the Smothering Abomination trigger, causing you to draw Golgari Thug from your library.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {1}.
Cast Golgari Thug by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with six or more phyresis counters on it

2363-3394-5220.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {0}.
Hangarback Walker enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Weatherlight Compleated.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Hangarback Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Weatherlight Compleated trigger, causing you to put a phyresis counter on it and draw a card, thus drawing Omarthis from your library.
Repeat.

3755-4050-5220.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana or less.
3755-4050-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

478-1283-6871.notes: You can instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability if mana allows.

3490-4871-5330-6829.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional artifact creature.
3490-4871-5330-6829.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Venom and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Venom trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

2043-5231-6671-6753.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Magic Pot that are 1/1 Soldiers.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing the Magic Pot tokens, adding {R}{R}.
When the Magic Pot tokens die, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

204-392-1858-2056-4785.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-392-1858-2056-4785.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Birgi and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more charge counters on it

198-4067-5802-6571.easyPrerequisites: There is a land on the battlefield.
198-4067-5802-6571.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {G} for each charge counter on it.
Cast Verdant Touch with buyback by paying {4}{G}.
Shantotto triggers, giving it +5/+0 until end of turn and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve Verdant Touch.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.

643-2178-2366-3346-5220.notablePrerequisites:
Bog Glider does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Bog Glider.
643-2178-2366-3346-5220.description:
Activate Bog Glider by tapping it and sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor dies, Mortuary and Bog Glider trigger.
Resolve the Bog Glider trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Dryad Arbor on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bog Glider ability from step 1, searching your library for Dryad Arbor and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

360-2034-2161-3490.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
360-2034-2161-3490.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Scion of the Swarm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Soul Warden trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

3314-4872-5238.notablePrerequisites: All permanents do not have summoning sickness.
3314-4872-5238.description:
Declare Ethereal Forager as an attacker.
Ethereal Forager triggers, returning Time Warp from exile to your hand.
Activate Chulane by paying {3} and tapping it, returning Ethereal Forager to your hand from the battlefield.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ethereal Forager by paying {3}{U}{U} and exiling Time Warp from your graveyard.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

859-1424-1545.notablePrerequisites:
Presence of Gond attached to Lurking Roper.
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
859-1424-1545.description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
The Elf Warrior enters the battlefield, triggering Trostani, causing you to gain life equal to the Elf Warrior's toughness.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

467-1636-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Shorikai does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to cause Shorikai to become a creature this turn.
467-1636-4050.description:
Cause Shorikai to become a creature.
Activate Shorikai by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to draw two cards, discard a card, and create a 1/1 Pilot creature token.
The Pilot enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Pilot, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

656-2232-3187-3771.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least four +1/+1 counters on it.
656-2232-3187-3771.description:
Cast Ugin's Conjurant, choosing one for X, but paying {0} due to Animar.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Ugin's Conjurant enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Wandering Archaic from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Wandering Archaic by paying {0}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Wandering Archaic enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Ugin's Conjurant from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
